pages.title: Explorer
pages.text: $(bold)The waystones on the Monoliths answer you: wake them and travel between those you have woken. Making, placing and breaking waystones wait for Attunement. Needs Magician as well.$(br2)$(thing)Diamond Age$(n), ring 7.$(br)$(thing)18 Focal Shards$(n).$(br)After Scout and Magician.

pages.title: Task
pages.text: $(bold)$(thing)Travel 10,000 blocks$(n)$(br2)Pays 2 Focal Shards once. Counts only once this node is reachable.
